standard.headline: What's Included in a Standard Clean
standard.intro: A thorough, room-by-room clean that keeps your home fresh and healthy. Every visit follows the same checklist so you always know what to expect.
kitchen: Disinfect countertops and backsplash
Wash and polish the sink and faucet
Wipe the outside of the refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, and microwave
Clean the stovetop surface and drip pans
Wipe cabinet fronts and handles, removing smudges and drips
Sweep and mop the floor
Take out the trash and replace the liner
bathrooms: Scrub and disinfect the toilet, top to bottom
Clean the sink, faucet, and vanity top
Scrub the tub, shower walls, and glass doors
Polish mirrors and glass until streak-free
Wipe towel bars, fixtures, and light switches
Sweep and mop the floor
Take out the trash
bedrooms: Dust furniture, shelves, and décor within reach
Dust ceiling fans and light fixtures within reach
Vacuum carpets and rugs
Sweep and mop hard floors
Make the beds (fresh linens if you leave them out for us)
Wipe windowsills
wholeHome: Wipe door handles, switches, and other high-touch spots
Spot-clean fingerprints on doors and walls

deep.headline: What's Included in a Deep Clean
deep.intro: Everything in our Standard Clean, plus the detailed work that builds up over time. Ideal for first-time visits, seasonal resets, or before and after hosting.
items: Wipe all baseboards, door frames, and doors, room by room

Wash light fixtures and fully clean ceiling fans
Scrub grout and tile in bathrooms

Wipe vents, registers, and exhaust fan covers
Clean behind and under furniture where it can be moved safely
Remove cobwebs from all corners and ceilings
Wash walls where marks and scuffs are visible

Our schedules fit your operation, including after-hours and weekends, so we never disrupt your day. We serve single suites and multi-floor buildings across the Denver metro.

general.a: We proudly serve the entire Denver metropolitan area and surrounding communities, including Denver, Englewood, Wheat Ridge, Arvada, Westminster, Thornton, Broomfield, Aurora, Centennial, Castle Rock, and Highlands Ranch.

general.q: Do you clean both homes and businesses?
general.a: Yes. We offer comprehensive residential cleaning (standard, deep, move-in/move-out, and short-term rental turnovers) and commercial cleaning (offices, HOAs, multi-unit building complexes, medical and dental facilities, and retail businesses).
Yes, GoPropertyCare is fully insured. Your property, furnishings, and peace of mind are completely protected on every visit.

general.q: Who will be cleaning my property?
general.a: A trained, vetted, and background-checked GoPropertyCare team. We never subcontract our cleaning staff to third parties.

general.q: Do you bring your own supplies and equipment?
general.a: Yes, we arrive fully equipped with professional tools, HEPA filtration vacuums, fresh microfiber cloths, and commercial-grade cleaning products. If you prefer that we use specific products of your own, just let us know when booking.

general.q: Do you use eco-friendly or pet-safe products?
general.a: Yes. Our core cleaning solutions are selected to be safe for children, families, and pets while remaining tough on grease and grime.

general.q: Do you offer a satisfaction guarantee?
general.a: Yes! If something was missed or not up to standard, notify us within 6 hours of job completion and our team will promptly return to reclean the area at no additional charge.
You can reach our team 24/7 by phone or text at (720) 590-8632, or by email at info@gopropertycare.com.

residential.q: How much does residential cleaning cost?
residential.a: You see your exact price instantly on our website. Simply select your service, enter your home size, bedrooms, and bathrooms, and receive your transparent upfront total before booking. No waiting for a quote.

residential.q: How do I book and pay?
residential.a: Booking takes less than 60 seconds online: choose your service, pick your desired date and time slot, enter your property details, and pay securely online.

residential.q: What's the difference between standard and deep cleaning?
residential.a: A standard cleaning keeps your home consistently fresh on a recurring schedule (dusting, vacuuming, mopping, surfaces, and trash). A deep clean covers the extra detail work regular visits skip, such as baseboards, door frames, inside microwave, detailed appliance exteriors, and scrubbing built-up grime.

residential.q: How often should I schedule my cleaning?
residential.a: We offer Weekly (20% discount), Biweekly (15% discount), and Monthly (10% discount) recurring options, as well as one-time bookings. Pick the frequency that fits your household and budget, and adjust anytime.

residential.q: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
residential.a: No. Most clients provide entry instructions during checkout, such as a lockbox code, smart lock keypad code, concierge access, or leaving a key. Our team locks up securely when finished.

residential.q: How should I prepare for my cleaning?
residential.a: Please pick up personal items, clothing, and toys from floors and counters, secure sensitive valuables, and let us know about any priority focus areas, pets, or entry instructions when booking.

residential.q: Do you clean homes with pets?
residential.a: Yes, we are pet-friendly! Please let us know about your pets when you book, and keep them in a comfortable, secure room during the cleaning visit so they stay calm and safe.

residential.q: How long will my cleaning take?
residential.a: It depends on the size and initial condition of your home and the chosen service. If conditions are out of scope upon arrival, we communicate this with you within the first hour of being at your property.

residential.q: Will a move-out cleaning get my security deposit back?
residential.a: We clean strictly to rigorous property manager move-out checklists (including inside cabinets and drawers). However, final deposit refund decisions belong solely to your landlord or property management company, so we cannot guarantee a refund.

residential.q: Do you clean short term rentals between guests?
residential.a: Yes. We specialize in Airbnb and VRBO turnovers, including same-day availability, unit staging, on-site or off-site laundry services, restocking supplies, and photo confirmation upon completion.
Yes! We offer oven interior detailing, refrigerator interior cleaning, interior window cleaning, blinds detailing, off-site laundry turnover, pet hair detailing, and patio/balcony cleaning.

residential.q: Do you offer discounts for recurring service?
residential.a: Yes, we offer recurring savings: 20% off for Weekly cleaning, 15% off for Biweekly cleaning, and 10% off for Monthly cleaning, applied automatically at checkout.
Tips are never required, but always greatly appreciated by our hardworking cleaning crews. 100% of tips go directly to the cleaners who serviced your home.

commercial.a: Every commercial space is unique. We provide a transparent custom quote after a quick walkthrough. Pricing factors in square footage, facility type, cleaning frequency, and specific scope of work.
A short 15-minute on-site visit where we tour your facility, discuss your operating hours, sanitary standards, and priorities, followed by a formal written quote delivered same-day.

commercial.q: How do I request a walkthrough?
commercial.a: You can fill out the contact form on our website, call or text us at (720) 590-8632, or email info@gopropertycare.com.

commercial.q: How soon can service start after the walkthrough?
commercial.a: Service can begin on your desired date, typically within 24 to 48 hours following proposal approval.

commercial.q: Do I have to sign a contract?
commercial.a: We operate on flexible month-to-month service agreements with a straightforward 30-day cancellation notice. No restrictive long-term commitments required.

commercial.q: Can you clean outside business hours?
commercial.a: Yes. We schedule around your operations, including evenings, early mornings, weekends, and holidays, so your day-to-day business is never disrupted.

commercial.q: What types of properties do you clean?
commercial.a: Corporate offices, retail stores and boutiques, HOA common areas and clubhouses, multi-unit residential communities, fitness centers, and medical/dental practices.

commercial.q: Do you clean medical and dental offices?
commercial.a: Yes. Our team is trained in bloodborne pathogen protocols and uses EPA-registered hospital-grade disinfectants with color-coded microfiber tools to prevent cross-contamination.

commercial.q: Who is my point of contact?
commercial.a: You receive a dedicated GoPropertyCare Account Manager as your single point of contact, available 24/7 for scheduling, adjustments, or questions.

commercial.q: How do you make sure the work stays consistent?
commercial.a: We adhere to strict operational checklists, conduct on-site supervisor quality audits, and provide timestamped photo completion reports after every visit.

commercial.q: Can we change the scope or frequency later? Can you work with HOA boards?
commercial.a: Yes, scope or frequency can be adjusted at any time with at least 15 days notice. We also work directly with HOA boards and property managers, providing written scopes, consistent schedules, and transparent itemized reports.

policies.q: What payment methods do you accept?
policies.a: For residential bookings, we accept all major debit and credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover) and digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay). Recurring commercial cleaning accounts are billed via invoice and support ACH bank transfer.

$0.00 is charged when you submit your booking request online (your card is securely saved on file via Stripe). Once our operations admin confirms crew availability and accepts your order, a 25% deposit is charged to lock in your appointment. The remaining 75% balance (plus any optional agreed surcharges) is charged automatically when the admin closes the completed order. Recurring commercial accounts are billed on a biweekly or monthly invoicing cycle.
Yes. Payments are processed securely through Stripe with end-to-end 256-bit encryption. We never store credit card or banking details on our servers.

policies.q: What is your cancellation and rescheduling policy?
policies.a: You can cancel or reschedule at no cost up to 24 hours prior to your scheduled service date and arrival window.

policies.q: What happens if no one is home or the team cannot get in?
policies.a: If our crew arrives and cannot access the property (lockout) or no entry method is provided, a 100% lockout fee is charged to compensate the crew's reserved time and dispatch costs, unless verifiable emergencies occur.
We do not provide monetary refunds. Instead, we uphold our 100% Satisfaction Guarantee: if any area was missed, notify us within 6 hours of service and our team will return to reclean it at no cost.

policies.q: What if I'm not satisfied with my cleaning?
policies.a: For residential cleanings, please let us know within 6 hours after work is performed. We will review your feedback and immediately send a team to fix any missed items.
GoPropertyCare is fully insured. Contact us as soon as possible with photos (within 24 hours after service is completed), and our management will review and resolve it promptly.
Colorado weather can be unpredictable. If severe weather or hazardous road conditions prevent our team from arriving on time, we will notify you in advance to coordinate an immediate reschedule.

miniFaq.title: Quick Questions
miniFaq.viewFullFaq: Have more questions? Read our full FAQ directory

standard.q: What does a standard cleaning include?
standard.a: We clean kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas: dusting, vacuuming, mopping, wiping surfaces, and taking out the trash.

standard.q: How often should I schedule it?
standard.a: Weekly, every two weeks, or monthly. Pick the frequency that fits your home and budget, and you can change it anytime.

standard.q: Do I need to be home?
standard.a: No. You can leave access instructions (lockbox, keypad, or front desk) and our insured team handles the rest.

deep.q: What's the difference between standard and deep cleaning?
deep.a: A deep clean covers the extra detail work a regular visit skips, such as baseboards, inside microwave, detailed appliance exteriors, and scrubbing built-up grime.
It depends on the size and condition of your home. If conditions are out of scope, we will communicate with you in the first hour of being at your property.
Before your first recurring service, at the change of seasons, or before and after hosting guests and events.

move_in_out.q: Will this help me get my security deposit back?
move_in_out.a: We clean to strict move-out checklists, but final deposit decisions belong to your landlord, so we cannot guarantee a refund.

move_in_out.q: Does the home need to be empty?
move_in_out.a: Cleaning is fastest and most thorough when the home is empty and personal belongings have already been packed.

move_in_out.q: Are the inside of cabinets and appliances included?
move_in_out.a: Inside cabinets and drawers are included! Inside refrigerator and oven detailing are available as convenient add-ons.

str_turnover.q: Can you clean between guests on the same day?
str_turnover.a: Yes, absolutely! We specialize in fast, same-day turnovers between morning check-out and afternoon check-in.

str_turnover.q: Do you handle linens and restocking?
str_turnover.a: Yes: on-site or off-site laundry, bed making, unit staging, and restocking guest supplies (paper towels, soaps, toiletries).

str_turnover.q: Will I know when the turnover is finished?
str_turnover.a: Yes. We send an instant message notification along with photo verification once your property is 5-star guest-ready.
